prompt.project_info: Create a cozy candid cinema portrait of an approved adult woman seated among red theater seats.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long dark-brown wavy hair and curtain bangs, fair skin, subtle natural glam, soft peach blush, nude lips, and relaxed direct gaze. She wears a fitted black crew-neck T-shirt, loose wide-leg light-blue vintage-wash jeans, clean white sneakers, and a small butterfly tattoo on the inner right wrist. She rests her chin on her right palm and her left hand on her knee.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 full-body/medium portrait at eye level, subject in a red plush cinema seat, multiple matching seats extending into depth, black headrests with existing gold '43X' seat marking, and dim theater background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cinematic ambient theater lighting with soft overhead glow on face, warm reflections, soft background shadows, cozy evening anticipation, realistic textile and denim texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-fidelity candid photography, natural perspective, sharp subject, gentle background depth, accurate hands and tattoo, subtle grain, preserve existing seat marking only when requested.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cozy photorealistic vertical 9:16 candid cinema portrait of an approved adult woman with long dark-brown wavy hair and curtain bangs, fair skin, subtle natural glam, soft peach blush, nude lips, and relaxed direct gaze. She sits in a red plush theater seat, rests her chin on her right palm with elbow supported, and rests her left hand on her knee. She wears a fitted black crew-neck T-shirt, loose wide-leg light-blue vintage-wash jeans, clean white sneakers, and has a small butterfly tattoo on the inner right wrist. Show multiple matching red cinema seats with black headrests extending into depth, existing gold '43X' seat markings only if retained by the reference, and dim atmospheric theater lighting. Use soft overhead glow, warm facial reflection, realistic textures, eye-level framing, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, altered seat marking, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face
